name: Gateway to the Frontier
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
They say that Ashenvale is the new frontier, and that the Mor'shan Rampart in the Barrens is the gateway to it.  That would be so cool to be a pioneer, carving everything you need out of the untamed wilds!  They say that this is where the Horde and Alliance will clash the most in the future, and I want to be there adventurer!

Would you take me to the Mor'shan Rampart so I can see what the frontier looks like, please?  I wanna see where the Horde is driving out those smelly night elves!
narrative.objectives: Take your ward to the Mor'shan Rampart in the northern part of the Barrens, just before entering Ashenvale.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Wow, Ashenvale is where real adventure happens! Have you ever fought in Ashenvale, adventurer? When I become a hero when I grow up, I wanna come to Ashenvale and fight for the glory of the Horde!

Thank you for taking me to the frontier, adventurer. You're the best!
narrative.endText: Go to the Mor'shan Rampart in the Barrens.
